title: Khóa luận tốt nghiệp - Quản trị dịch vụ Du lịch và Lữ hành

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply research methods to analyze and solve practical problems in the tourism and travel industry.
Identify, analyze, and resolve issues in tourism management.
Effectively communicate and present research findings.
Critically evaluate and interpret data related to tourism and travel.
Demonstrate leadership in managing and coordinating tasks during practical training.
Manage and execute projects related to tourism and travel.
Understand and apply principles of tourism management in practical settings.
Apply business administration principles to tourism and travel industry.
Adhere to professional ethics and legal standards in tourism and travel.
Work independently and responsibly in practical training settings.
